episodes.synopsis: Utsuro's master plan is in full effect as Earth is taken over by the Altana Liberation Army. With Odd Jobs still not back from Rakuyo, the residents of Kabuki District have a hard time adjusting to life as a colony.
episodes.title: Try As You Might to Make a Natural Perm Go Away, It Will Always Return

episodes.synopsis: Katsura, Sakamoto, and Nobunobu arrive at the S.S. Heavenly Bird and try to bring the Liberation Army to the negotiating table. Meanwhile, the various factions in Edo begin to make their move.
episodes.title: Flavoring is Best in Small Quantities

episodes.synopsis: With the Odd Jobs looking for the Tendoshu, things heat up on the Liberation Army's main ship. Shijaku has promised his cooperation to Nobunobu, but now he must convince his comrades.
episodes.title: A Delinquent's Kid Has Long Neck Hair

episodes.synopsis: The encounter with Utsuro leaves Gintoki feeling more helpless than ever before. That's when he receives a very powerful reminder.
episodes.title: The Line Between Tenacious and Annoying Is Paper-Thin

episodes.synopsis: The return of some familiar faces breathes new life into Earth's resistance, but they're as troublesome as they've always been! And when the Liberation Army brings out its big guns, it's up to Gengai to respond.
episodes.title: Geezers Carve the Things They Shouldn't Forget into Their Wrinkles

episodes.synopsis: The machines have done their part and left Earth's future in the hands of humanity. But Gengai's cannon has also painted a huge target on the Kabuki Distruct, and the Liberation Army immediately marches toward it.
episodes.title: Machines That Pick Up Useless Habits Are Called People

episodes.synopsis: Prince Hata's past is revealed along with the history of Planet Okoku. Can Katsura and Hasegawa really get them on Earth's side?
episodes.title: Men Must Live Not Long or Thick, but Hard

episodes.synopsis: The Kabuki District is under siege, and the fearsome Dakini race arrive on the scene. How can the District and its residents cope with this onslaught?
episodes.title: Ogres Are Weak Against Tiny Heroes Like the Inch-High Samurai

episodes.synopsis: The Shinra finally make their move and look to capture the creator of the virus cannon with their underhand tactics. But right as things get desperate, the "boss" of the Kabuki District intervenes
episodes.title: Bragging About Your Own Heroic Deeds Will Make People Hate You, So Make Others Do It For You

episodes.synopsis: Under the leadership of the Kabuki District's Four Devas, the residents are beginning to drive out the enemies inside the town. However, they still have to deal with Ougai, the leader of the Dakini force.
episodes.title: Jump and Power Creep Go Hand-in-Hand

episodes.synopsis: After successfully driving the Liberation Army out of the Kabuki District, its residents enjoy a well-earned break. However, they know that the peace won't last for long.
episodes.title: Peace and Destruction Are Two Sides of the Same Coin

episodes.synopsis: Gengai has gone missing, and Ensho has brought out his trump card. How can the Odd Jobs, the Shinsengumi, Katsura, Sakamoto, and Nobunobu get out of this desperate situation?
episodes.title: Bushido Is Found One Second Before Death
